description: This file defines a set of tools for interacting with the Google Sheets API, including creating, retrieving, updating, and managing spreadsheet data and ranges. It includes schema definitions, base classes, and factory functions for generating specific tools based on requested actions.

classes.name: BaseGoogleSheetsTool
classes.description: A base class for Google Sheets API tools, providing request handling and authorization.

classes.name: CreateSpreadsheetTool
classes.description: Tool for creating new Google Spreadsheets.

classes.name: GetSpreadsheetTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving spreadsheet details by ID.

classes.name: GetValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for fetching cell values from a spreadsheet range.

classes.name: UpdateValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for updating cell values in a spreadsheet range.

classes.name: AppendValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for appending values to a spreadsheet range.

classes.name: ClearValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for clearing values from a spreadsheet range.

classes.name: BatchGetValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving multiple ranges of values.

classes.name: BatchUpdateValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for updating multiple ranges of values.

classes.name: BatchClearValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for clearing multiple ranges of values.

methods.name: makeGoogleSheetsRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the Google Sheets API with proper authorization and error handling.

methods.name: createGoogleSheetsTools
methods.description: Factory function to generate a list of Google Sheets tools based on specified actions and parameters.
